notes:
**Windows** — run `ruze_0.0.23_x64-setup.exe`.
**Linux** — `flatpak install ruze-0.0.23.flatpak`, then `flatpak run com.ruze.chat`.
**Android** — sideload `ruze-0.0.23.apk`. arm64 devices, Android 8.0 or newer.

---

### Added

- **See which connections are direct and which go through a relay.** There was
  no way to tell from inside the app whether your voice was being forwarded by
  a relay server or going straight to the other device — which is the first
  thing worth knowing when a call sounds wrong. A small meter now sits beside
  your name: green when everything is direct, amber when anything is relayed.

  Opening it draws the connections as three columns — this device, the relays,
  the peers. A direct connection springs across and skips the middle column; a
  relayed one visibly goes through it. A key in the corner says which line is
  which. Hovering any peer gives the addresses behind it, and clicking one
  keeps them there while you read them; the list beside the diagram filters by
  name, server or device id. A relay can see who is talking to whom and never
  what is said; both kinds of connection are encrypted end to end.

- **Join a server by scanning its invite.** An invite is handed over as a QR
  code as often as a block of text, and the first-run screen could only take
  the text — which meant typing a ticket by hand on the device least suited to
  it. On a phone that screen now offers the camera, and pasting is still there
  underneath for everyone else.

### Changed

- **No status picker before you have joined anything.** Setting yourself to
  Busy on the first-run screen asked a question with no audience: there is
  nobody in any server to read the answer, because there is no server yet. It
  is where it always was once you are in one.

### Fixed

- **Tapping "Download and install" twice on Android no longer downloads the
  update twice.** Android does the download in the background, so the button
  came straight back to life a moment after it was pressed and an impatient
  second tap started the whole thing again. It now reads "Downloading…" and
  stays shut until the check runs again.
